dogecoin.text: Crypto market updates: Bitcoin, Dogecoin, and Ethereum

Exciting developments in the crypto space: El Salvador abandons Bitcoin as legal tender, while Coinbase pushes for US regulators to allow banks to offer crypto services, and Neptune Digital Assets makes a significant investment in Dogecoin.
Coinbase urges US regulators to clarify crypto services, Neptune Digital Assets buys 1 million Dogecoin, and Paxos acquires EU Electronic Money Institution license.
